cold.speaker: Orsa Kell
cold.text: Stranger. The mayor decides who works for whom around here. Talk to her first.

intro.speaker: Orsa Kell
intro.text: The mayor's new hand. Good. I cannot sell what I cannot reach.

trade.speaker: Orsa Kell
trade.text: Bone, scale and iron. Folk bring me what the sea and the old graves give up, and I make it into things that last. If anything worth the name comes in, wyvern bone, say, I will teach you to work it.

scrap_offer.speaker: Orsa Kell
scrap_offer.text: Iron. The tide leaves nails and ship-bands along the shore. Three good pieces and I can finish a blade I owe. I will pay for it.

deliver.speaker: Orsa Kell
deliver.text: Ship-stamped, salt-cured, and every piece of it here. Salvagers pay by weight and by honesty. You came back with all of it, and that counts for something. Tell the mayor I said so.

scrap_reminder.speaker: Orsa Kell
scrap_reminder.text: Three pieces of iron scrap, along the shore. Nails, bands, anything that rings.

scrap_return.speaker: Orsa Kell
scrap_return.text: Three. They ring true. Twenty coin, and I will not haggle you down.

after_scrap.speaker: Orsa Kell
after_scrap.text: The blade is done and paid for. When you come across bone that is older than it should be, bring it here first.
